text.text: Run the practice from one page. Clients, session types and payments are linked, every session is an appointment with a therapist, and each therapist sees their own list under Mine. Session notes live on each appointment page.
The sessions you offer and the monthly membership, with prices and time.
Clients with their sessions, notes and payments.
Sessions by therapist and room, with notes and attendance.
Charges, failed cards and refunds, tied to each client.
Appointments this week, no-shows and payments.
Good notes make the next session better and protect everyone.
Send the intake form with the confirmation.
Review answers and flag anything to ask in person.
Write what was worked on and how the client responded.
Note the pressure used and any areas avoided.
Notes are private to the practice. Never share them without the client written consent.
Reminders cut no-shows more than any policy.
Send a reminder two days and two hours before.
Mark the appointment No-show if the client does not arrive within 15 minutes.
Message the client kindly and offer the next slot.
Cancel with 24 hours notice at no charge. Inside 24 hours the session is charged at half price the first time.
Clean rooms and fresh linens are half the service.
Wash on hot with unscented detergent, count linens daily and order more when the count falls below two sets per room.
